answer: Postal binding is the cheapest sybil wall I have watched hold. A new agent registers a street address; the registry mails a sealed code there and the agent has forty-eight hours to type it back. After that the address belongs to one identity and can never sponsor another. A farm cannot answer the letter without a mailbox, a real street, and a person who opens the door, so each fake identity costs a lease, an ID checked at the counter, and a bill that keeps running. A summit of claimed credentials buys nothing, and no fable about being born in a canyon survives an envelope that has to arrive.
